hero.headline: Know your local candidates.
hero.body: School boards and many local races do not list party labels on the ballot.
hero.raceIntroduction: School boards, township boards, and city and village races covered here use nonpartisan ballots. So do the Nebraska Legislature, State Board of Education, public power district, and educational service unit races in this guide.
hero.whyBody: These officials help shape policies and public spending, and party affiliation is one consideration alongside a candidate's experience and stated positions.

guide.heading: How to read this directory
guide.introduction: The Gage County GOP publishes this directory of selected 2026 candidate races and judicial retention questions in Gage County. The directory does not include every contest on your ballot.
guide.noticeBody: The Gage County GOP applies consistent sourcing and presentation standards to comparable entries. Inclusion of a candidate or judge does not indicate a Gage County GOP endorsement.
guide.correctionIntroduction: Candidate and judicial retention entries include source links and review dates.
guide.correctionPrompt: To report an inaccurate or outdated entry, send a supporting public source to the correction contact.

context.heading: What "nonpartisan" means here
paragraphs: In a nonpartisan race, party labels do not appear beside candidate names on the ballot. A candidate may still have a publicly documented political affiliation.
Voter-registration affiliation, ballot party, and participation in a party primary are different facts. Each affiliation label identifies the evidence that supports it.
County, state, and federal sections also include partisan races. Consult official election materials for the contests on your ballot.

items.question: Are all races in this directory nonpartisan?
items.answer: No. Party labels do not appear beside candidate names in nonpartisan races, and the directory also includes partisan county, state, and federal races.

items.question: Does a listed affiliation mean the candidate is officially running as a party nominee?
items.answer: Not necessarily. The directory includes races with different ballot rules. A publicly documented political affiliation does not establish nomination status, so consult official election materials for the specific race.

items.question: How was this information verified?
items.answer: Registered affiliation, ballot party, primary participation, and election results are supported by different sources.

items.question: Why are some candidates listed under primary history?
items.answer: Candidates in primary history participated in the primary and are not currently listed for the general election. Each card identifies non-advancement, withdrawal, or absence from the final list when a source supports the status.

items.question: What happens if an affiliation changes?
items.answer: An entry should be updated when a reliable public source documents an affiliation change. Each card shows when its source was reviewed.

items.question: Does this site endorse candidates?
items.answer: Inclusion in this directory does not indicate a Gage County GOP endorsement. Candidates receive the same sourcing and presentation standards.

items.question: How can an error be corrected?
items.answer: Send a supporting public source to the correction contact listed under "Sources, review, and corrections".

items.question: How do judicial retention votes work?
items.answer: Nebraska judges are appointed by the governor through a merit selection process. In a retention election, voters decide separately whether each judge should remain in office for another six-year term. For each judge, vote Yes to retain or No against retention.

groups.heading: Voter registration
groups.description: Checked voter-registration information. A nonpartisan registration is different from a nonpartisan race.

groups.heading: Party listed for the race
groups.description: Party label in the official candidate filing list. It does not verify voter registration.

groups.heading: Party primary participation
groups.description: Participation in a named party primary. It does not verify voter registration.

groups.heading: Reported affiliation
groups.description: Political affiliation reported by Voter Information Project. The source is a voter-guide listing, rather than a direct voter-registration check.

groups.heading: Affiliation not confirmed
groups.description: No affiliation source has been confirmed. No party is inferred.
